title: Amgen Named to The Wall Street Journal's Inaugural 2026 Best Companies for the Future List
summary: The Wall Street Journal has released its inaugural 2026 Best Companies for the Future list, recognizing companies positioned to succeed in a rapidly changing business environment. Amgen ranked No. 39, earning an overall score of 63.5 out of 100.
body_markdown:
The Wall Street Journal has released its inaugural *2026 Best Companies for the Future* list, recognizing companies positioned to succeed in a rapidly changing business environment. Amgen ranked No. 39, earning an overall score of 63.5 out of 100.


The ranking assesses companies across six categories: AI readiness, innovation, talent readiness, financial fitness, resilience, and agility. Amgen also received the second-highest resilience score among all companies evaluated.


This recognition reflects Amgen's ability to advance its longstanding mission of serving patients today while remaining prepared to meet their needs in the years ahead.
